review.method: acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the production baseline report over that installation, rustc and Cargo.lock; validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. The consumer trace is cs_content::catalog::baseline::retail_baseline + baseline_report_json, the same functions `cs-inspect catalog --cs-path` writes. The image count is compared with the texture-name entries cs_formats::gamez::read_gamez_materials finds in each container, and a located row's span is checked to lie in a texture.zbd. The measurement is in docs/findings/2026-10-11-f14-d-10-image-collection.md. LIMITATION: Most image rows are explicit unknowns: the containers spell their texture names with a stored extension (`name..tif`) that the world archives' stored names do not carry, and F08's lookup compares the folded name exactly with no extension handling, so no archive entry was located for them. Nothing was stripped, aliased or searched across archives. Affected content: every image row carrying the image_name_unresolved unknown (counts in the collection's name_without_archive_entry gap). Resolving task: the F08/F09 decision on how a container's name maps to an archive entry. LIMITATION: Every name of planes.zbd is an explicit unknown: the shared airframe library belongs to no world group, and which texture archive its names resolve against is not established (deferred item 3 of the F10-C.02 finding). Affected content: the image rows of ZBD/planes.zbd. Resolving task: the planes texture-archive binding. LIMITATION: The `fallthrough` lookup (rimage.zbd, loose .tif/.bmp) is not walked, because the collection reads only the world's own archive through the world mount; a name the original would find there is an unknown here. Affected content: those image rows. Resolving task: the F08/F09 binding that owns the image list (#688). LIMITATION: No material row has an edge onto an image row yet. Affected content: the material collection. Resolving task: a follow-up that adds material-to-image edges. LIMITATION: No row claims a runtime consumer, so every image row is unreachable from the declared roots and stays counted in coverage.unreachable_by_kind. Affected content: the reachability accounting of the image collection. Resolving task: the renderer texture binding stages.
